statements.impact_statement: The fork contains upstream fix 91c507a39abfce14b5c8541cf284330e22208c0f: manifest PUT is bounded to 4 MiB and blobStore.Get uses getContent/readAllLimited with a 4 MiB limit for stored manifest GET. Source: https://github.com/goharbor/distribution/tree/ac7c4cedc2f4d45347630beceaaa1639bb9c771a. Go assigns this modified fork a v0 pseudo-version, which incorrectly compares below the fixed v2 release. .ci/test-distribution-vex.py verifies the exact source tag, commit and security-file fingerprints; runtime regression tests exercise the fixed boundaries.
